workedExamples.prompt: Compare “table”, “rabbit” and “robot”. What clues can help?
workedExamples.solution: Table ends in consonant-le; rabbit follows a common VCCV pattern; robot can use a VCV division. Confirm each with the whole-word pronunciation.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner's division sounds wrong. What should be done?
workedExamples.solution: Try another plausible division, read each part, blend the word and check conventional pronunciation and meaning.
